questions.text: The 7-digit number A67856B is divisible by 3. Find the least possible value of (A + B). Ans A). 0 B). 3 C). 1 D). 4 Correct Answer: C

A group of 6 identical workers can finish a task in 9 days. How many days will it take if only 3 of them work together to complete the same task? Ans A). 27 days B). 15 days C). 12 days D). 18 days Correct Answer: D

The average sale of cars by a dealer per day in the month of March, other than on Saturdays and Sundays, is 191. The average sale of cars per day on Sundays is 160. What is the average sale of cars per day on Saturdays, if the first Saturday is on the 3rd of March and average sale of cars per day for the whole month is 187? Ans A). 196 B). 191 C). 186 D). 193 Correct Answer: B
